CustomField.description: Idempotency means that processing the same request twice has the same effect as processing it once. Inbound: a request whose Idempotency-Key header the same user already sent to this service is not run again. It gets the stored response when the earlier call completed with the same body, and HTTP 409 when the body differs. A key another user sent is a separate request. A retry with the same key and body after a failure links to the failed call (Previous Attempt), and with Resolve Issues on, a success resolves the earlier failures' issues. Outbound: a key is built as a SHA-256 hash of the endpoint, the request parameters and the body, and sent as the Idempotency-Key header; a retry is safe only if the remote system honours that header, and two calls with identical endpoint, parameters and body share a key.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Inbound: a repeat of an Idempotency-Key the same user already sent to this service gets the stored response instead of running again, and a retry after a failure is linked to the failed call. Outbound: a key built from the endpoint, parameters and body is sent as the Idempotency-Key header, so a call with no response can be retried safely when the external system honours it. A key the call already carries is always sent, whether this box is ticked or not.
CustomField.label: Idempotency Enabled
